About Jack

From understanding people to designing for them.

I'm an Eagle Scout with a Bachelor's in Psychology and a minor in Sociology. In my senior year I pointed that human-behavior foundation at UX, completed an international research & design program, and earned my BCS UX and IBM Data Science certifications.

I want to help companies create intuitive, integrated, and accessible experiences — digital and physical — by truly understanding customers' behaviors, preferences, and needs.
